about: Decode cards for the page (arisweb/static/js/spectrum.js, decResult) and for the engine's tests: the twelve example cases of the Decode card design, each a whole card as /api/decode/<job> gives it in job.card (the keys the card has had so far plus the signal report's keys). 'extra' holds three more for what the examples do not reach (every step action, a dongle not used, a level at the noise, a failed decoder). 'old_card' has no report_v: the page draws it as before the signal report. Every new key may be missing or null in a real card. The 'cards' section is written by test/make_decode_fixtures.py from the rules in arislib/sigreport.py (old keys by hand, new keys from the rules: never edit those here); 'extra' and 'old_card' are written by hand. Example words, not measurements: simulation only.
